marketing_wrapper: Cream #fcf8ed backdrop (pale blue on 04) with a serif headline that italicises a key phrase, a small orange monospace uppercase eyebrow ('CASH FLOW', 'BUDGETING'), award laurels on 01 and 04, and a realistic iPhone with an orange frame showing ~50-55% UI. 04 is mostly a family photo with two floating UI cards.

typography.display: Wrapper: transitional serif with italic emphasis plus an orange monospace eyebrow. In-app: neutral grotesk at medium/semibold for titles ('Reports', 'June Budget')
typography.numerals: lining, medium weight; table columns right-aligned and look tabular (unsure)
typography.weights: Balances medium (not bold); budget figures bold with grey regular qualifiers ('remaining'); labels regular
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence case in app; uppercase tabs 'NET WORTH / CASH / CREDIT CARDS' with slight tracking

palette.accent_strategy: Semantic and per-content: green income/left-to-budget, red expenses, teal goals and chart line, per-category colours in the Sankey; brand orange lives on the device frame, eyebrow and logo, not inside screens.
palette.source: palette.json 02 and 06 (#f6f5f3 25-29% UI canvas), 01 (#f5f5f2), 03 (#ffffff 24% cards); wrapper cream #fcf8ed 30-34%; semantic colours visual

shape.radius_language: small-medium: cards ~10-12pt, stat tiles ~10pt, dropdown fields ~10pt bordered; segmented tabs and range chips pills
shape.borders_shadows: Bordered dropdowns and editable amount fields; cards on warm grey with no visible shadow; dashed underlines on 'Remaining' and '% of assets' to signal tooltips

density: high: table-like budget rows, Sankey with 15+ labelled nodes, net worth chart plus account list on one screen
layout: Accounts: hamburger + bell, centred title, more + add; NET WORTH/CASH/CREDIT CARDS tabs, net worth figure and change, full-width area chart, range chips, then account group cards. Reports: segmented Cash Flow/Spending/Income, Chart and Display dropdowns, Sankey. Budget: full-width green 'Left to budget' banner, three progress-bar summaries, then an editable Budget/Remaining table.
navigation: Hamburger menu (top left) rather than a visible tab bar in these crops; centred titles; segmented pills for sub-views
imagery_and_icons: Bank logos in circles, emoji as category icons (house, apple, coffee, money bag), photo headers on goals; wrapper photography of a family
signature_visual_move: A full-height Sankey diagram of income to spending categories, coloured per category and labelled with emoji, as a primary report.
tells_present: Emoji as icons (category emoji in the Sankey and budget rows)
Cream plus serif plus orange (store wrapper only; it is the brand system here, so a false-positive risk)

direction_fit.why: Text record had it as calm modular money with low confidence. The screens show a light, data-dense, semantically coloured board of tables, bars and charts with no shell loudness inside the app. None of the 17 fits cleanly; Glance Board's one-line-per-entity rows and strict semantic colour are the closest. The serif/cream/orange identity is store-wrapper only.

notes: MONEY ANATOMY. Net worth '$748,606' medium weight ~1.8x body, rounded to dollars with no cents; portfolio '$270,239.50' medium with cents at the same size; $ full size. Change '↑ $32,483.59 (4.5%) 1 month' with green arrow and figure, grey period. List amounts right-aligned medium black with cents, timestamp below ('4 hours ago'). Budget: bold spent figure + grey 'remaining' qualifier; editable budget amount in a bordered box ('$8,400') beside the remaining amount in a green pill ('$4,200'). Goals: '+$4,000.00' and '+$3,000.00' in green for saved/available, black for spent; 'At risk' yellow chip with yellow progress. Negative shown once as '-$1,' (hyphen, looks truncated in the marketing data). Tabular: columns appear aligned, unsure. Charts: teal line with pale gradient area fill and a dotted baseline (net worth); two-series line chart (portfolio teal vs S&P orange) around a dashed 0% line with legend dots; stepped green area for goal progress with a dashed projection to a target marker; Sankey with category colours; horizontal budget bars with a tick marking today. Range chips 1M/3M/6M/YTD/1Y/ALL, selected in grey pill.
